label: Necessary-being node, GOD_NAMING_1 reading: necessarily one existent meets the divine description
paraphrase: Necessary-being node under the descriptive reading of the name 'God': some actual root n (concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground) is GOD_4, the one GOD_4, with the classical attributes, and at every world v accessible from w something existing at v uniquely (among what exists at v) satisfies the God-description GodAt at v. GodAt v x is a primitive parameter: x satisfies at v the conditions the name's descriptive content requires. The being that satisfies it at v need not be n, and nothing relates GodAt at other worlds to GOD_4.
